title: Feature Neutralization in MQL5: Orthogonalizing Trading Signals Against Confound Factors

for: The residual applied to a bar that is not in the fitted window is the neutralized signal: residual = y − (b₀ + b₁f₁ + ... + b_k f_k)

Correlation of the raw signal with the volatility factor was +0.140 before neutralization; for the out-of-sample residual — computed bar by bar against a beta that had not yet seen that bar — it falls to −0.004
The trend-slope factor moves from +0.848 to +0.101
Mean rolling R² across the fitted windows was 0.402: on average, the two injected confounds explained a little over a third of that window's raw-signal variance

A 20-bar rate-of-change momentum signal on XAUUSD M5 is mechanically larger in magnitude when the underlying is more volatile, because bigger bars produce bigger price differences over any fixed lookback — a backtest that looks strong in volatile, trending stretches and flat in quiet ones may just be tracking ATR

The same happens with trend strength: a positive momentum reading during a strong trend is partly genuine continuation and partly 'the market has been going up,' which a plain ADX reading already captures

The Expert Advisor's InpTradeNeutralized switch picks between this stream and the raw signal's, so the raw and neutralized backtests in the Testing section differ only in which z-score feeds the entry test, never in how they are logged or exited
A new entry is only taken when GetFailStreak() is at or below InpMaxStaleBars; once the beta has failed to refresh for too many bars in a row, the EA stops opening new positions on it

non_fatal: No explicit specification of the entry/exit logic beyond z-score thresholding — the article describes trading 'on the z-score' but does not define the exact condition (e.g., cross above/below threshold, bar close beyond threshold, etc.), though it is implied by the EA code using `ManageSignals()`; however, that function is not shown in the text.

The raw signal is defined as a 20-bar rate-of-change of Close, and confound factors use ATR and MA slope — all standard spot-forex indicators, but the article does not specify how gaps, weekends, or non-trading hours affect the bar indexing (e.g., whether `shift+InpMomentumPeriod` may land on a weekend bar with no price data); this is mitigated by explicit `CopyClose` return-code checks, but edge-case robustness (e.g., partial holidays) is not discussed.

The neutralization procedure depends on a rolling window of fixed size (e.g., 60+ bars for 3 parameters), which introduces look-ahead bias *if* the window size is chosen post-hoc on the same data used for backtest evaluation — but the article does not claim optimality or selection; it treats window size as a fixed hyperparameter, so this is a design choice, not a fatal flaw.

The article assumes stationarity of factor-signal relationships across windows — explicitly acknowledged as an empirical, not mathematical, guarantee — but does not provide out-of-sample stability diagnostics beyond one dataset; this is a modeling limitation, not a fatal implementation flaw.

judge.reject_reason: Статья не описывает конкретное торговое правило для входа: нет чёткого условия входа (направление и логика срабатывания) на основе нейтрализованного сигнала или z-оценки. Упоминается только, что 'торгуют z-оценкой' и используется порог InpEntryZ = 1.5, но не указано, как именно формируется сигнал — например, пересечение порога, закрытие бара за порогом, сравнение с предыдущим значением и т.д. Функция ManageSignals() — ключевая для логики входа — не приведена в тексте статьи, её реализация отсутствует. Без неё невозможно восстановить детерминированное условие входа long/short. Это фатальный порок: статья описывает инструмент (нейтрализацию), а не торговое правило.
judge.summary: Статья представляет библиотеку нейтрализации признаков в MQL5, которая удаляет линейную зависимость торгового сигнала от заданных конфаундов (например, нормализованной волатильности и наклона скользящей средней) через скользящую регрессию. Она подробно описывает математику, численную устойчивость и интеграцию в советник, но не определяет конкретное правило входа — лишь указывает, что используется z-оценка и порог 1.5, без деталей триггерной логики.
